title: net1 v4 on the data regenerated under the frozen settings, against a net1 retrained on it
description: net1 v4's three datasets regenerated with the same specs under the settings frozen at 1365f0e: the setups' 64 MB TCP limits and the send buffer sized to four windows of the path (exp-data-net1-broad-30s-73, -60s-74, -ood-75; net1 v4 was trained on releases 5, 8 and 9, with a 4 MB send buffer). This trains a net1 with net1 v4's chosen settings (experiments/specs/net1v4.json: three members, dropout 0.05, width 512) on the new data and reports it next to net1 v4 itself (--compare) on the same new rows. If it is at least as good in validation loss and coverage it becomes net1 v5; the hyperparameters are searched again only if they get worse.
run: uv run python experiments/net1_train.py "$OUT/net1-d0.05-w512-s$SEED" --spec experiments/specs/net1v4.json --set dropout=0.05 --set width=512 --seed $SEED --data "$IN/d30/campaign-train30" "$IN/d60/campaign-train60" --ood competitors="$IN/ood/campaign-ood-competitors" --ood loss="$IN/ood/campaign-ood-loss" --ood rtt="$IN/ood/campaign-ood-rtt" --ood buffer="$IN/ood/campaign-ood-buffer" --compare "$IN/grid/$(cat "$IN/grid/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"
